text: On the bridge team, the investigators write: nobody seemed to have urged the master to accelerate the turn, or to give warning of the looming danger.

text: That is not one man. That is a room.
On the alarm: the general emergency alarm was not activated immediately after the impact, and that delayed the management of everything that came after it.

text: And underneath all of it: nearly two thousand people who had never walked to a muster station, because the operation they had bought a ticket from showed them a video instead.

text: Passengers testified that despite the chaos, crew members supported them with humanity and effective action — and ferried them to the boats and off the ship.

text: A thousand crew, most of them with no instruction coming from anywhere, improvised an evacuation. That is not the story this accident is usually told as.
